notablePrerequisites: You have at least one white card in hand.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Watcher of the Roost, adding {C}{C}.
When Watcher of the Roost dies, Yedora triggers, returning Watcher of the Roost from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Watcher of the Roost by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Watcher of the Roost's morph ability by revealing a white card from your hand, turning it face up.
Watcher of the Roost triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
